title: Seeded Train/Test Split
learning_objectives: Split data into disjoint train and test sets
Keep X and y aligned when shuffling
hints: Convert with `np.asarray`, validate, and create one `rng`.
Non-stratified: `perm = rng.permutation(n)`; slice into test/train index arrays.
Stratified: loop over `np.unique(y)`, permute `np.flatnonzero(y == c)` and split each.

failure_feedback.advice: Index X and y with the same permutation.
Use rng = default_rng(seed); perm = rng.permutation(n); test = perm[:n_test].
Split each class separately with round(n_c * test_size) test samples.
Train and test must partition all rows.
